description: Place a signed limit or stop-loss order on Epsilon. Limit: fills when the market reaches limit_price or better. Stop-loss (stop_loss=true): triggers when price drops to limit_price. The order is signed locally with the configured wallet and executed by keepers — funds stay in the wallet until fill. limit_price is expressed as token_out received per 1 token_in. Requires a prior approve_token for token_in.

amount_in.description: amount of token_in to sell, human units

confirm.description: set true to confirm placement (only required when the server runs with EPSILON_REQUIRE_CONFIRM=1)

expiry_hours.description: order lifetime in hours; 0 = never expires

limit_price.description: trigger price: token_out per 1 token_in, human units

slippage_bps.description: max fill slippage in basis points

name: place_limit_order
